instructions: Warm olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and wilt the spinach, 1-2 minutes.
Add whisked eggs and scramble gently until just set.
Fold in crumbled feta and diced tomato off the heat.
Serve with Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat (240 g).
